formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x1 → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (9 : ℕ) x1 = fun (x3 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => x3 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x3 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x3 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x3 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x3 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x3 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x3 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x3 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x3 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x3 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x3 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x3 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ))) → ∃ (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x4 ∧ x4.size ≤ x1.size ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (9 : ℕ) x4 = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (9 : ℕ) x1 ∧ ((∃ x5 ∈ [(0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ))], ∀ (x6 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), (x4.wires (List.ofFn x6)).getD (9 : ℕ) Bool.false = !x6 x5) ∨ ∃ x5 ∈ [((0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)))], ∃ (x6 : Bool), ∀ (x7 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), (x4.wires (List.ofFn x7)).getD (9 : ℕ) Bool.false = if x6 = Bool.true then x7 x5.1 && x7 x5.2 else x7 x5.1 || x7 x5.2)
plain_statement: The edge function of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges). Every circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates for it has an equal circuit of that kind, no larger, whose first gate computes NOT x_0, NOT x_4, or the AND or the OR of one of the input pairs (0,1), (0,2), (0,3), (0,4), (0,6), (4,6).
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 15 gates computes its edge function
